standards.applies_because: US cellular (850 MHz band) — FCC equipment authorisation of the cellular radio
US equipment authorisation and RF exposure (SAR, §2.1093)
Wi-Fi / Bluetooth radios and digital device
EU RED: cellular, Wi-Fi, BT, GNSS, SAR and EMC under one declaration
Lithium cell shipped in the product
Carrier / industry certification of the cellular modem (needed to be sold through operators)

risks.risk: A phone cannot realistically be designed from scratch by a start-up (modem, RF, OS, certification)
risks.mitigation: ODM reference platform with pre-certified modem; customise enclosure, colours, display, sensors and software

risks.risk: Carrier certification and OS licensing (Google Mobile Services / AOSP) gate the launch
risks.mitigation: Pick the ODM platform already certified on the target carriers; AOSP-based launcher for the 'no social apps' experience

risks.risk: Software updates and security patches for years
risks.mitigation: Contract the ODM for a patch schedule (e.g. 3 years) with the BSP

risks.risk: SAR re-test when the antenna area or back material changes
risks.mitigation: Keep the ODM's antenna layout; metal back → budget a SAR + OTA re-test

tests.name: Radio + SAR (FCC ID, RED)
tests.method: Accredited lab; re-use the ODM's modular reports where the RF design is unchanged

typical_electronics: Application processor SoC with LTE modem (ODM reference board)

prototype.method: ODM engineering samples in a CNC aluminium / SLA body
steps: Shortlist ODMs with a reference platform close to the brief (size, modem bands, price tier)
Get engineering samples; build the software experience (launcher, app policy) on AOSP
CNC / SLA the custom back and colours around the ODM's board
Pre-scan radio and SAR on the custom body
Carrier pre-test with the ODM before committing tooling
